review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review; not independent approval
review.decision: Use shared semantic operation labels without dropping raw calls; compact mouse-first rows, retain touch targets
review.notes: User provided Activity/Codex comparison. Source inspection proves native parsed_cmd already normalizes read/search/list; raw callTitle currently overrides it. Implement bounded first batch only: labels, complete argv previews, density. Preserve calls/count/raw evidence, unknown and mixed operations, no invented hierarchy or execution success. Shared App/Trace model is generated for browser. No live user sessions, product service, installation or release. Original screenshots are user evidence, not independent UI/device acceptance. Cases reviewed before edits.

cases.description: Activity/App/Trace share semantic titles and retain raw tool facts across agents
cases.setup: Actual ToolSteps, shared call presentation and generated browser artifact with Codex parsed operations and Claude/DSH/OpenCode/Kimi-style aliases; unknown provider tools and a Run code parent plus Exec records.
cases.action: Render read/list/search/command/code/edit operations with and without call metadata in both languages; inspect raw facts and record counts.
cases.expected: Known normalized operations take primary title; unknown methods retain real provider/name. Call facts, inputs, count and ordering are unchanged. Actual RN row and browser inspector/Trace agree; no fabricated children, successes or per-file calls.

cases.description: Command preview unwraps only complete bounded argv and leaves scripts/raw intact
cases.setup: Canonical activity preview with shell -c/-lc arrays, ordinary argv, multiline scripts, meaningful target summaries, malformed/truncated/oversize input and nonstring values.
cases.action: Generate bounded one-line preview for each case; compare native/browser results and input bytes.
cases.expected: Readable actual command instead of serialized argv when structure is complete and recognized; semantic file/query summaries remain. Never execute/parse shell text as authority, infer read/search from arbitrary words, unescape malformed JSON, change Raw input, invent output or expand record count. Keep 160-character spoken bound and surrogate safety.

cases.description: Mouse Activity rows become compact while touch and accessible content remain usable
cases.setup: Actual shipped CSS/DOM and RN ToolSteps row, isolated synthetic long filenames, code, both languages and large text; no user conversation.
cases.action: Inspect fine-pointer/coarse-pointer layout, narrow edge and keyboard expanded state; verify RN minimum hit area.
cases.expected: Fine pointer row min-height30px with bounded one-line summary and visible focus; touch/coarse remains44px and RN44pt. Full details remain keyboard accessible, long content stays within edge, record label matches icon and accessibility name. Static fixtures do not certify real iOS/Android VoiceOver or device accessibility.
